span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THREE SOURCES FOR A MODEL'S ASSUMPTIONS ARE NAMED, AND WHAT THEY ASSERT IS DECLARED UNOBSERVABLE IN THE SAME CLAUSE: we have assumptions to make - FROM SCIENCE, INTUITION, OR OTHER DATA ANALYSES - that involve STRUCTURES WE BELIEVE EXIST IN THE DATA BUT THAT WE CANNOT DIRECTLY OBSERVE. The provenance of the assumptions and the inaccessibility of their objects are stated together
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A FORMALISM IS DESCRIBED AS A LANGUAGE, AND THE INFERENCE PROCEDURE AS ITS READING: Quotation withheld ASSUMPTIONS about data and its HIDDEN STRUCTURE, and the corresponding algorithms LET US ANALYZE DATA UNDER THOSE ASSUMPTIONS, INFERRING THE HIDDEN STRUCTURE THAT BEST EXPLAINS OUR OBSERVATIONS. The notation is cast as a vocabulary and the computation as its interpretation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE PAPER'S OWN TASKS ARE SPLIT INTO TWO KINDS WITH DIFFERENT WARRANTS, AND THE UNOBSERVED PART IS PUT IN SCARE QUOTES: in DESCRIPTIVE tasks the models help EXPLORE the data with the hidden structure probabilistically FILLED IN; in PREDICTIVE tasks they FORM PREDICTIONS ABOUT NEW OBSERVATIONS. The same machinery serves two purposes that would be judged by different evidence
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A MODEL CLASS IS DEFINED BY WHAT IT COSTS RATHER THAN BY WHAT IT CONTAINS: NONCONJUGATE MODELS are MODELS WHERE A RICHER PRIOR IS USED AT THE EXPENSE OF MATHEMATICAL CONVENIENCE - and they HAVE EXPANDED THE SUITE of tools available. The category's definition is a trade-off, with the thing traded away named explicitly
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: ONE ALGORITHM IS RE-DESCRIBED AS ANOTHER, AND THE EQUIVALENCE IS STATED AS AN IDENTITY OF STEPS: the classical coordinate ascent algorithm CAN THUS BE INTERPRETED AS a projected natural gradient algorithm - and updating a parameter by taking a natural gradient step OF LENGTH ONE IS EQUIVALENT TO PERFORMING A COORDINATE UPDATE. Two names for one procedure, with the exchange rate given
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A FORMAL FACT IS GIVEN AN INTUITIVE ROUTE ALONGSIDE THE FORMAL ONE, AND BOTH ARE LABELLED: FORMALLY this is most easily seen via other perspectives, THOUGH IT CAN BE SEEN INTUITIVELY WITH the stick-breaking construction - and then THE INTUITION IS THAT more of the stick is absorbed in the first break locations. The paper marks which of its two explanations is which
span.note: about this quote: RE-SLICED off an UNCLOSED OPENING BRACKET. The first cut ended "...drawn from Beta(1", truncated inside a distribution's argument list. `audit_span_orphan_bracket` did NOT catch it: that tool looks for a CLOSER with nothing to close, and this is the mirror case - an OPENER with nothing closing it. A real gap in the guard, logged as its own question.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE EVALUATION CRITERION IS OPERATIONALISED AS A PROBABILITY ASSIGNED TO WITHHELD WORDS: under the predictive distribution, A BETTER MODEL WILL ASSIGN HIGHER PROBABILITY TO THE HELD-OUT WORDS - and the procedure divides each document into observed and held-out words, KEEPING THE SETS OF UNIQUE WORDS DISJOINT. What BETTER means is fixed by a number and a partition, and the partition rule is stated
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A PROCEDURE IS NAMED BY COMPOSING TWO EXISTING NAMES: interleaving the coordinate ascent updates with an update that increases the bound IS CALLED VARIATIONAL EXPECTATION-MAXIMIZATION - and the stochastic version is then described by what it does DIFFERENTLY, updating the two simultaneously. The name records its parentage and the variant is defined against it
span.note: about this quote: RE-SLICED: the first cut ended "we update alpha simultaneously with", dangling in front of a symbol the span does not include.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The general algorithm is derived only for conjugate exponential-family models and does not cover nonconjugate models such as correlated or dynamic topic models.
span.note: what this limits: the reach of the derivation: WE DEVELOPED OUR ALGORITHM WITH CONJUGATE EXPONENTIAL FAMILY MODELS, so nonconjugate models are outside it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Convergence is only to a local optimum, and very small minibatches can lead to a poor one.
span.note: what this limits: any solution the algorithm returns: IT IS GUARANTEED TO CONVERGE TO A LOCAL OPTIMUM BUT TAKING LARGE STEPS ON THE BASIS OF VERY FEW DATA POINTS MAY LEAD TO A POOR ONE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The quality of the solution and speed of convergence depend on how the forgetting rate, delay and minibatch size are set.
span.note: what this limits: the reported convergence behaviour: THE QUALITY OF THIS STATIONARY POINT AND THE SPEED OF CONVERGENCE MAY DEPEND ON HOW THESE PARAMETERS ARE SET
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: What is optimised is a bound standing in for a quantity the method cannot compute.
span.note: what this limits: any model comparison made on this objective: the marginal probability cannot be computed exactly, so what is maximised is a fitted variational lower bound on it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A prior is made exchangeable for simplicity, and the paper notes the conditional then is not.
span.note: what this limits: results depending on the Dirichlet prior here: the parameters are all set to the same value for simplicity, and the paper notes that conditioning makes the resulting conditional non-exchangeable
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The evaluation is built from a split of each test document's words, constructed to be disjoint.
span.note: what this limits: the held-out probability figures reported here: each test document's words are divided into observed and held-out sets, with the sets of unique words kept disjoint
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: How many topics a collection needs is answered by the model's own posterior.
span.note: what this limits: the number of topics reported for a collection: it is determined by the posterior distribution of the hidden structure under this model, not by anything independent of it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: optimized distribution → posterior
span.note: THE INDEXING / PROXY RELATION - Q-299. `from` STANDS IN FOR `to`. We have no type for it: `causes` asserts production, and `operationalised-as` says the authors CHOSE a measure, whereas a proxy claim says THIS STANDS IN FOR WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT AND WE KNOW IT IS NOT THE SAME THING. Measured at 8% of papers. The substitution at the centre of variational inference, stated in one line: 'we use the optimized distribution as a proxy for the posterior'.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a topic - A WEIGHTED DISTRIBUTION OVER THE VOCABULARY: not a subject, a theme or an aboutness, but a probability vector over words, shown to a reader by printing its most frequent members - which is why a multi-word name has no way to stay together inside one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: topic proportions - A DISTRIBUTION OVER TOPICS, so a distribution over distributions: the same word does duty at two levels in one sentence, and a document's 'topics' are weights on objects that are themselves weights on words
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the ELBO - A LOWER BOUND SUBSTITUTED FOR THE THING WANTED: the algorithm maximises a bound on the log marginal probability rather than that probability, and the gap between them is not reported because computing it would require the quantity the bound exists to avoid
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
